title: Quetta Acquisition Corporation 8-K Filing
summary: Quetta Acquisition Corporation (QETA) received delisting notices from Nasdaq due to failure to meet the minimum Market Value of Listed Securities (MVLS) requirement and a requirement of at least 400 total holders, with an additional basis for delisting added when the company failed to file its Annual Report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025.
key_points: Nasdaq notified the company on April 6, 2026 of delisting due to failure to meet minimum MVLS requirement
Company also fails to meet continued listing requirement of at least 400 total holders under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5450(a)(2)
Second delisting notice issued April 20, 2026 due to failure to file Annual Report on Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
Company has requested a hearing before Nasdaq Hearings Panel scheduled for May 14, 2026
Company notified the Hearings Panel on April 21, 2026 of intent to address the filing issue at the hearing
Company intends to file its Annual Report as soon as practicable
